response.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(facetfaces) as baseline_val FROM scanmesh WHERE facetfaces IS NOT NULL), site_avgs AS (SELECT sm.zoneref, MAX(s.entrystat) as entrystat, AVG(sm.facetfaces) as site_avg FROM scanmesh sm LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sm.zoneref), status_avgs AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg) as status_avg FROM site_avgs WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept AS (SELECT sa.site_avg, sta.status_avg, b.baseline_val FROM site_avgs sa INNER JOIN status_avgs sta ON sa.entrystat = sta.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE sa.site_avg > sta.status_avg) SELECT AVG(site_avg) as avg_kept_sites_faces, AVG(site_avg - baseline_val) as avg_exceed_baseline, AVG(site_avg - status_avg) as avg_exceed_status FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: The baseline includes all mesh records in scanmesh with non-NULL facetfaces, including those whose zoneref does not match any site.zoneregistry

alternatives.interpretation: Only mesh records whose zoneref matches a site.zoneregistry are included in baseline and per-site calculations (sites with NULL entrystat still qualify for baseline, but not for per-status filtering)
